instruction: Set my weekday wake up alarm snooze to 5 minutes.
notes: Single-app task (phone). The agent learns the phone password, logs in, lists alarms to discover the id of the weekday wake-up alarm (label mentions wake up, repeat_days = Mon-Fri), then calls update_alarm passing only snooze_minutes=5 so that snooze_minutes is the sole changed field (the evaluation requires exactly one updated alarm with only that field changed). The alarm and snooze objects on supervisor-complete-task are task records (not API arguments); complete_task is called without an answer. The reference solution may additionally call phone.show_alarm to inspect the alarm details, which is optional and not modeled. Static init facts target-alarm/target-snooze pin the goal to the correct alarm and value.
